limitations: constant mu and k with ideal-gas Stokes closure; no turbulence, variable properties, radiation or solid conjugate heat transfer
full momentum row norm is a dimensional explicit diffusion bound, not a proof of nonlinear energy/entropy stability on arbitrary skew grids
Couette starts from analytic steady profile; measures discretization consistency, not convergence from rest
small-amplitude continuum modes and short App runs do not qualify arbitrary Cut-cell skin friction, heat flux, shock-boundary-layer interaction or long-time accuracy
independent last-step reconstruction with two RK stages and all adjacent-history mass/energy budgets, not independent replay of all fields
explicit time step remains limited by small Cut-cells; open boundaries use zero viscous traction
actual App and runtime tested on macOS arm64; no new multiplatform CI used as qualification; no main integration; checkMesh unavailable
